Bruce Hornsby - Steinway & Sons
s: A University of Miami alum, Hornsby has partnered with The Frost School of Music to establish the Creative American Music Program, a curriculum designed to develop the creative skills of talented young artist/songwriters by immersing them in diverse American folk, blues, and gospel traditions that form the foundations of modern American songwriting. He is managed by Red Light Management. Bruce Hornsby has been a Steinway Artist since 2004.
